reasons: Piece [1] shows the skill's 'global flags' wording directly causes a refused call ('cli.py --seat BENCH bridge take' fails). The text is read before every rimflow call, so the error recurs rather than being one item's quirk. The fix is a 2-line in-place correction with the exact right and wrong forms, changes no ruling, gate or cap, and the recheck is observable in future lessons. Two caveats: making the parser accept --seat before the verb would be an alternative fix, but not clearly a better one while the doc is simply wrong. The diff also extends 'after the verb' to --target, --mode and --owner-said, which the evidence does not show directly, though the original text grouped them as one class.
